overview:
This check monitors battery health on MacOS and Windows laptops.

**Minimum Agent version:** 7.75.0
setup:
### Installation

The Battery check is included in the [Datadog Agent][2] package.
No additional installation is needed on your server.

### Configuration

The configuration is located in the `battery.d/conf.yaml` file in the `conf.d/` folder at the root of your [Agent's configuration directory][1]. See the [sample `battery.d/conf.yaml`][4] for all available configuration options. When you are done editing the configuration file, [restart the Agent][5] to load the new configuration.

### Validation

[Run the Agent's `status` subcommand][6] and look for `battery` under the Checks section.

**Note**: If no battery is detected in the system, the check will not run.

[2]: https://app.datadoghq.com/account/settings/agent/latest
[1]: https://docs.datadoghq.com/agent/guide/agent-configuration-files/
[4]: https://github.com/DataDog/datadog-agent/blob/main/cmd/agent/dist/conf.d/battery.d/conf.yaml.example
[5]: https://docs.datadoghq.com/agent/guide/agent-commands/#start-stop-and-restart-the-agent
[6]: https://docs.datadoghq.com/agent/configuration/agent-commands/#agent-information

metrics.name: system.battery.charge_rate
metrics.description: The current rate of battery charge or discharge

metrics.name: system.battery.current_charge_pct
metrics.description: The current percentage of battery charge

metrics.name: system.battery.cycle_count
metrics.description: The number of charge and discharge cycles the battery has experienced

metrics.name: system.battery.designed_capacity
metrics.description: The theoretical capacity of the battery when new

metrics.name: system.battery.maximum_capacity
metrics.description: The battery's current fully charged capacity

metrics.name: system.battery.maximum_capacity_pct
metrics.description: The percentage of maximum battery capacity relative to when it was new

metrics.name: system.battery.power_state
metrics.description: The current state of the battery. Reports 1 if the battery has a valid state and 0 if no state is available

metrics.name: system.battery.voltage
metrics.description: The current battery voltage across the battery terminals
